مننت (form I)
# مَنَنْتُ (manantu) /ma.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of مَنَّ (manna)
# مَنَنْتَ (mananta) /ma.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of مَنَّ (manna)
# مَنَنْتِ (mananti) /ma.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of مَنَّ (manna)
# مُنِنْتُ (munintu) /mu.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of مَنَّ (manna)
# مُنِنْتَ (muninta) /mu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
